decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Time limit 

The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.

Reason: To accord with the provisions of paragraph W, Part 3, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 2 - In accordance with approved plans 

The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered Location Plan, 3283-P-010, 3283-P-030, 3283-P-110, 3283-P-130, Cover letter dated 12 June 2025 and Noise Impact Assessment Issue 01. Received: 13/06/2025) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the agreed details and to accord with the provisions of paragraph W, Part 3, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 3 - Restrictions on use of floor below dwelling

The parts of the building used for Class E of Part A, Schedule 2 to the Use Classes Order shall be situated on a floor below the lowest part of the building used as a flat. The ground floor must not be used in whole or in part as a flat.

Reason: To accord with the provisions of paragraph G.1(a) and (b) of Class G, Part 3, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 4 - Restrictions on use of dwelling

The hereby permitted dwelling (Class C3) shall remain in use as a flat within the meaning of Class C3 of Part C, Schedule 1 to the Use Classes Order and for no other purpose, except to the extent that the other purpose is ancillary to the use as a dwelling.

Reason: To accord with the provisions of paragraph G.1(c)(i)(ii) of Class G, Part 3, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 5 - Waste and recycling

Before the dwelling hereby approved is first occupied, the collection point for the dwelling's domestic waste shall be agreed by the Council's Waste and Recycling team. All domestic waste in association with the approved development shall be placed within the designated waste receptacle for flats above shops, for collection. Purple refuse sacks shall not be left on the public highway.

Reason: To protect the quality of the local environment and to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the public highway and to accord with the provisions of Paragraph W, Part 3, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 6 - Noise
The hereby approved dwelling shall comply with the submitted Noise Impact Assessment, including removing rear condensers and install sound insultation, prior to the occupation of the dwelling.

Reason: In order to protect future occupiers from unacceptable noise levels and accord with the provisions of Paragraph W, Part 3, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
description: Prior approval for the change of use of the second and third floor from Use Class E to a 1 bedroom, 2 person self-contained residential unit Use Class C3
